## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// A partition of vertices into connected components. ComponentLabels[v] is the
// zero-based component of vertex v, in [0, ComponentCount).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Component_(graph_theory))
type ConnectedComponents
    implements IValue
{
    ComponentLabels: Array<Integer>;
    ComponentCount: Integer;
}

// A topological ordering of a directed graph. IsValid is false when the graph
// contains a cycle, in which case OrderedVertexIndices is partial or empty.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Topological_sorting)
type TopologicalOrder
    implements IValue
{
    OrderedVertexIndices: Array<GraphVertexIndex>;
    IsValid: Boolean;
}

//==
// # Coloring, partitioning, flow, and matching

// An assignment of colors to vertices such that adjacent vertices differ.
// Colors are zero-based integers in [0, ColorCount).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graph_coloring)
type GraphColoring
    implements IValue
{
    VertexColors: Array<Integer>;
    ColorCount: Integer;
}

// A partition of vertices into parts (for load balancing or clustering).
// PartLabels[v] is the zero-based part of vertex v, in [0, PartCount);
// CutEdgeCount is the number of edges whose endpoints lie in different parts.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graph_partition)
type GraphPartition
    implements IValue
{
    PartLabels: Array<Integer>;
    PartCount: Integer;
    CutEdgeCount: Integer;
}

// A directed flow network: edge weights are nonnegative capacities
// (unit-agnostic), with distinguished source and sink vertices.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flow_network)
type FlowNetwork
    implements IValue
{
    VertexCount: Integer;
    Edges: Array<WeightedEdge>;
    SourceIndex: GraphVertexIndex;
    SinkIndex: GraphVertexIndex;
}

// The result of a maximum-flow computation. EdgeFlows is parallel to the
// network's edge array (same units as the capacities); SourceSideVertices[v]
// is true when v lies on the source side of a minimum cut.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maximum_flow_problem)
type MaxFlowResult
    implements IValue
{
    TotalFlow: Number;
    EdgeFlows: Array<Number>;
    SourceSideVertices: Array<Boolean>;
}

// A matching in a bipartite graph with LeftVertexCount left and
// RightVertexCount right vertices. MatchedRightIndices[l] is the right vertex
// matched to left vertex l, or -1 when unmatched.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matching_(graph_theory))
type BipartiteMatching
    implements IValue
{
    LeftVertexCount: Integer;
    RightVertexCount: Integer;
    MatchedRightIndices: Array<GraphVertexIndex>;
}

//==
// # Layout

// The algorithm family used to position a graph's vertices for display.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graph_drawing)
type GraphLayout = ForceDirected | Circular | Layered | Grid | Radial | Spectral;

// A graph paired with 2D positions for its vertices (unit-agnostic canvas
// coordinates). Positions is parallel to the implicit vertex range.
type LayoutedGraph
{
    Graph: Graph;
    Positions: Array<Point2D>;
}
```
